sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a commanding position and will be strong favourites against bottom-half opposition. Alsager arrive in poor form with just one win in their last five and are struggling in the relegation zone.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday as they look to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, in third place, travel to Eccleshall in what could be a competitive mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two mid-table sides, before Brereton Social hosts Wednesfield in a Wednesday midweek replay. Bilston Town, fifth in the standings, travel to Foley Meir looking to maintain their consistent form. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, who are in dire straits having lost their last five matches consecutively. Market Drayton Town host high-flying New Mills in a potentially significant clash for those seeking playoff positions. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in a fixture between struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle. Widnes Town, pointless at the bottom, visit Brereton Social on Saturday, offering one of the league's most desperate teams a chance to find their first win of the season.
